ds.name: ZIGZAG Design System (ZDS)
ds.description: Official Kakaostyle engineering account of the ZDS rebuild, CSS-variable token work, and product-card unification.

tokens.note: Three current public product surfaces. Current computed Pretendard JP did not match a loaded FontFace, so no font family is promoted. The legacy pink palette and unobserved commerce states were removed.
